channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Zimbabwe Business & Economic Policy
channel.description: Strictly Zimbabwe business, finance, mining, investment and economic-policy stories — curated from foreign press and policy press. Each item ships with a branded headline card for social autolists.

item.title: Zimbabwe’s Manufacturers Are More Confident. So Why Is Production Falling?
item.description: ZIMSTAT’s Q1 2026 Business Tendency Survey shows manufacturing confidence rising to 6.2 even as the PMI fell to 39.2 and production balances turned sharply negative across key industries. #Zimbabwe #Business #ZimbabweEconomy #ZimbabweNews
item.dc:creator: Nigel Njini Chapwanya

item.title: VFEX Surpasses US$8 Billion as Dollar Market Expands
item.description: The Victoria Falls Stock Exchange has surpassed US$8 billion in market capitalisation, but a methodology change and Old Mutual’s return account for most of the jump, and the figure needs to be read against how little is actually trading. #Zimbabwe #Business #ZimbabweEconomy #ZimbabweNews
item.dc:creator: Nigel Njini Chapwanya
